points.description: States that arrays are passed to functions by reference (e.g. the function works on the original array / its address, so changes affect the original).
points.partial_credit: Part marks for a vague or half-correct statement, e.g. mentions passing the address/pointer without saying reference, or says by reference but with a minor error.

rubric.notes: Full marks for stating that arrays are passed by reference, in any wording (e.g. "by reference", "as a pointer to the first element so the original is modified"). Part marks for vague or partly right answers, such as only describing the address being passed without clearly saying reference. No marks for saying by value (a copy) or for answers that don't address how the array is passed.Extra correct detail is fine.
